tables.title: E19a. The fight step and the design's targets (wiosenna)
tables.measured: 500 games per cell. Rounds, comeback, never trailed and the fight columns: planner vs planner with the same best deck. Veteran vs new: 200 collection pairs. Skill: planner vs greedy, same deck. Shape: a deck of few strong cards and cheap fillers against a deck of even cards (30 collections). Fights per match counts contested objectives over the match; a flip is a contested objective whose controller the fight changed.
